Agent Name: WebSurfer
, Step Number: 6
, Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer misreported the English Wikipedia page as listing Antonio Leonviola’s place of death as Los Angeles, California, USA. Subsequent checks (including the same Wikipedia page and IMDb) show the correct place as Rome, Lazio, Italy. This erroneous extraction created a false conflict and would lead to a wrong conclusion about the death place.
